verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated data-export or account-exit feature in the evidence. Portability comes only indirectly: environments can be defined from standard Dockerfiles, files on a devbox can be read through the file API or over SSH, and execution logs can be retrieved. Snapshots save disk state, but nothing shows they can be exported out of Runloop in an open format. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of account data (devboxes, snapshots, storage objects, agents, benchmark results), open-format snapshot or image export, an offboarding/data-deletion process, and independent corroboration.
